evidence: Filled Wedding Details form (partners, date, budget, guests) via Get Started, saved, dashboard updated to show "Alex & Jamie" heading and Jun 15, 2027 date.
Clicked Update Details, changed date to Sep 20, 2027 and budget to $45,000, saved, dashboard reflected new values immediately.
Dashboard shows Wedding Date, Budget, Guest Count, and Planning Progress cards, all populated with saved values.

issue: No validation preventing negative guest count
actual: Entered -5 into Expected Guests field and saved; dashboard displayed Guest Count as "-5" with no error or rejection.

issue: No validation on wedding budget input; invalid negative value accepted
actual: Entered -100 into Budget field and saved; dashboard displayed Budget as "$-100" with no error or rejection, indicating the field has no numeric validity constraint.

issue: No validation preventing past wedding dates
actual: Entered 2020-01-01 (a past date) into Wedding Date field and saved; it was accepted without error, dashboard displayed "Jan 1, 2020" and the "days until your special day" countdown text disappeared silently instead of showing a validation error.

evidence: Venues page filters by Venue Type (Garden: 8→2) and Price Range (Garden+Luxury: 2→1), narrowing results correctly.
Typed "beach" into venue search box; results filtered to 2 of 8 venues matching keyword (Sunset Beach Resort, Coastal Haven).
Clicked heart/favorite icon on Sunset Beach Resort venue card; navigated to Favorites page which showed "Saved Venues (1)" including Sunset Beach Resort.
Venue list updated immediately (no reload/apply needed) when toggling Venue Type and Price Range filters and when typing search keyword.
Each venue card displays location (e.g. Napa Valley, CA), price tier (e.g. Luxury $$$), venue/service type (e.g. Garden), capacity, and description.
Filter combos (Garden+Luxury) and keyword search ("beach") both returned precisely matching venues with no irrelevant or missing entries.

issue: View Details button does not navigate to a details page
actual: Clicked "View Details" on multiple venue cards (both on /venues and /favorites); the URL and page content remained unchanged (still /venues or /favorites), no details page or modal appeared.

evidence: Checklists page displays 6 curated checklists (12+ Months, 8-10 Months, Ceremony, Reception, Attire, Honeymoon), each viewable with expandable task lists.
Clicked "Save to Dashboard" on "12+ Months Before" checklist; button changed to "Saved" and checklist appeared on Dashboard under "Your Saved Checklists" (0 of 6 completed).
Checked "Set a budget" checkbox in expanded "12+ Months Before" checklist; checkbox became checked and Progress updated in real time from 0% to 17% (1/6 tasks).

Expanded "12+ Months Before" checklist shows 6 detailed, practical tasks (Set a budget, Choose a wedding date, Book your venue, Start your guest list, Hire a wedding planner, Book photographer & videographer), each with a helpful description.

After a full page reload/navigation, "Sunset Beach Resort" remained in Favorites (Saved Venues (1)) and the "12+ Months Before" checklist retained its "Saved" status and 17% progress from the earlier completed task.
